_doc: ADR-0093 D-5 (grill-t36 D-005): the claim-surface ROLE REGISTRY. Role attribution used to be read off filename shape, so naming an artifact changed its governance; this surface makes it a declared fact and is what retires the filename selectors registered by ADR-0091 D-E and ADR-0092 D-S1. DECLARED FACTS, NOT A DERIVED SURFACE: role attribution is a discretionary judgment with no mechanical source, so `generated_from` is forbidden here (D-003 stamps that field on generator output; if the role were derivable this file would not exist). Consumed by scripts/check-audit-surface.js (order 229) and scripts/check-post-land-sentinel.js (order 231); asserted by scripts/check-claim-surface-roles.js (order 232), which owns the fail-closed direction - a tracked claim-surface artifact with no row is an error, because a file that calls itself an examiner report is invisible to a checker reading only examiner rows. BACKFILL (D-005 clause 4, this commit): the pre-existing claim surface is registered once as a SEMANTIC REGISTRATION, not a pardon; rows accumulate and are never deleted, a retired path becomes `archived`, and deleting a row is an owner act plus a Declaration. Roles were NOT inferred from filename tokens (that inference is the lesion): every pre-existing row is the registering agent's registration, and `mechanical` marks the machine-produced diff/hash captures only. THE EXAMINER CLASS IS OWNER-RATIFIED and is EMPTY here: examiner rows ride the ADR-0086 exception channel (requested_by / reason / expires_at / scope, then owner ratification naming a `ratified_by` that may never equal `declared_by`), and the registering agent may REQUEST a row but never self-certify one - so no agent-authored row asserts examiner authority anywhere in this file. Re-attributing an existing row is a fenced act (owner + Declaration), not an agent edit. CLAIM_RE (the claim-surface range) is retained in scripts/shared/claim-surface-roles.js: a range assertion is not a role assertion.

field_governance._doc: ADR-0086 three-class field governance, inherited by D-005: the path->role mapping is fenced (rule change = Declaration), examiner rows are the exception channel (owner-ratify), the descriptive header fields are editorial.
